filed.title: Update Crystal 1.20.1 -> 1.21.0
filed.body:
Crystal 1.21.0 is out; the images have 1.20.1.

Release notes: https://github.com/crystal-lang/crystal/releases

To take it: set [images] crystal = "1.21.0" in config.toml and deploy. The weekly rebuild runs every project's tests in the new image, so it is also the check that each Crystal project builds and passes on 1.21.0. If one fails, the old image stays and the rebuild log says which; file a fix ticket for it. Then move this ticket to done.

filed.title: Update Claude Code 2.0.0 -> 2.1.0
filed.body:
Claude Code 2.1.0 is out; the images pin 2.0.0.

Changelog: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

To take it: set [images] claude = "2.1.0" in config.toml and deploy. The weekly rebuild picks it up and keeps the old image if the new one fails its checks (or run `factory rebuild` on the host now). Then move this ticket to done.
